title: 1. ଲେଖକ ପରିଚୟ
content: Kapil Dev, full name Kapil Dev Nikhanj, is one of the greatest cricket players and all-rounders in the history of Indian cricket. Born on January 6, 1959, in Chandigarh, he led the Indian cricket team to its first-ever World Cup victory in 1983. This chapter is an autobiographical piece adapted from his life and writings, including his autobiography 'Straight from the Heart'. Through his narrative, Kapil Dev shares his childhood memories, his early passion for sports, and his inspiring journey to becoming a legendary cricketer.

title: 2. ଲେଖକଙ୍କ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ
content: ଏହି ଅଧ୍ୟାୟ ଲେଖିବା ପଛରେ Kapil Dev ଙ୍କର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ହେଉଛି ନିଜର ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳର ସ୍ମୃତି, କ୍ରୀଡ଼ା ପ୍ରତି ଭଲପାଇବା ଏବଂ କ୍ରିକେଟର ହେବାର ସଂଘର୍ଷମୟ ଯାତ୍ରାକୁ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ସେୟାର କରିବା। ସେ ଦର୍ଶାଇବାକୁ ଚାହାନ୍ତି ଯେ ଦୃଢ଼ ଇଚ୍ଛାଶକ୍ତି, ନିରନ୍ତର ପରିଶ୍ରମ, ଅନୁଶାସନ ଏବଂ ଖେଳପ୍ରତି ନିଷ୍ଠା ରହିଲେ ଗୋଟିଏ ସାଧାରଣ ପରିବାରର ପିଲା ମଧ୍ୟ ବିଶ୍ୱସ୍ତରରେ ଭାରତର ନାମ ରଖିପାରିବ।

title: 3. ଅଧ୍ୟାୟ ପରିଚୟ
content: 'Kapil Dev' ହେଉଛି BSE Odisha Class 10 English ପାଠ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ଏକ ପ୍ରେରଣାଦାୟୀ ଅଧ୍ୟାୟ। ଏହା Kapil Dev ଙ୍କ ଆତ୍ମଜୀବନୀମୂଳକ ରଚନା। ଏଥିରେ ତାଙ୍କ ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳର ନଟଖଟ ପ୍ରକୃତି, ଚଣ୍ଡୀଗଡ଼ରେ ବିତାଇଥିବା ସମୟ, ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ଫଳ ବଗିଚାରୁ ଫଳ ଚୋରି କରି ଖାଇବାର ଆନନ୍ଦ ଏବଂ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସମୟରେ କ୍ରିକେଟ ପ୍ରତି ତାଙ୍କର ଗଭୀର ଆକର୍ଷଣ ଓ କ୍ରିକେଟର ଭାବରେ ସଫଳତା ପାଇବାର କାହାଣୀ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରାଯାଇଛି।

title: 4. ସରଳ କାହାଣୀ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା
content:
Kapil Dev ଙ୍କ ଜନ୍ମ ଚଣ୍ଡୀଗଡ଼ର ଏକ ମଧ୍ୟବିତ୍ତ ପରିବାରରେ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଛୋଟବେଳୁ ସେ ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଚଞ୍ଚଳ ଓ ଖେଳପ୍ରିୟ ଥିଲେ। ସେ ନିଜ ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ମିଶି ପଡ଼ୋଶୀଙ୍କ ବଗିଚାରୁ ଆମ୍ବ, ସାପେଟା ଓ ଆତ ତୋଳି ଖାଇବାକୁ ଭଲପାଉଥିଲେ। ସେହି ନଟଖଟ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ଯୋଗୁଁ ଅନେକ ସମୟରେ ଧରାପଡ଼ି ଗାଳି ମଧ୍ୟ ଶୁଣୁଥିଲେ।

ବଡ଼ ହେବା ସହିତ ତାଙ୍କର ଖେଳ ପ୍ରତି ରୁଚି ବଢ଼ିଲା। ପ୍ରଥମେ ସେ ଫୁଟବଲ, ଟେବୁଲ ଟେନିସ୍ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ଖେଳ ଖେଳୁଥିଲେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସମୟରେ କ୍ରିକେଟ ତାଙ୍କ ଜୀବନର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଅଙ୍ଗ ପାଲଟିଗଲା। ଚଣ୍ଡୀଗଡ଼ର Sector 16 Cricket Club ରେ ଯୋଗଦେବା ପରେ ତାଙ୍କର କ୍ରିକେଟ ଜୀବନର ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ତାଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଶିକ୍ଷକ Desh Prem Azad ଙ୍କ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନରେ ସେ ଜଣେ ଚମତ୍କାର ଦ୍ରୁତ ବୋଲର ଓ ବିସ୍ଫୋରକ ବ୍ୟାଟସମ୍ୟାନ ଭାବେ ଗଢ଼ିଉଠିଲେ।

୧୯୭୫ ମସିହାରେ ହରିୟାଣା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରଥମ ଶ୍ରେଣୀ କ୍ରିକେଟ ଖେଳିବା ପରେ ୧୯୭୮ ମସିହାରେ ସେ ଭାରତୀୟ ଜାତୀୟ କ୍ରିକେଟ ଦଳରେ ସ୍ଥାନ ପାଇଥିଲେ। ତାଙ୍କ ନେତୃତ୍ୱରେ ୧୯୮୩ ମସିହାରେ ଭାରତ ପ୍ରଥମ ଥର ପାଇଁ Cricket World Cup ଜିତି ଐତିହାସିକ ସଫଳତା ହାସଲ କରିଥିଲା।

title: 5. ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ / Stanza ଅନୁସାରେ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା
content:
Paragraph 1:
Kapil Dev describes his childhood memories in Chandigarh. He reveals that as a child, he was extremely energetic and full of life. He spent most of his time playing outdoor games with his friends.

Paragraph 2:
He shares interesting anecdotes about picking fruits from nearby orchards with his friends. Picking mangoes and pomegranates was an adventure for them. Sometimes they were caught by orchard owners, which resulted in scoldings, but it added fun to his childhood.

Paragraph 3:
Gradually, his focus shifted from casual games to organized sports. Although he played table tennis and football initially, cricket eventually captured his heart and passion.

Paragraph 4:
He joined Sector 16 Cricket Club in Chandigarh under coach Desh Prem Azad. Through rigorous practice and dedication, he developed into a world-class fast bowler and all-rounder, leading India to the 1983 World Cup victory.

title: 6. କଠିନ English ଶବ୍ଦର ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଅର୍ଥ
content:
୧. Autobiography - ଆତ୍ମଜୀବନୀ (Self-written life story)
୨. Childhood - ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳ / ଛୋଟବେଳ (Early life)
୩. Anecdote - ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ମଜାଦାର ଘଟଣା (A short amusing story)
୪. Orchard - ଫଳ ବଗିଚା (Fruit garden)
୫. Mischievous - ନଟଖଟ / ଦୁଷ୍ଟ (Playfully naughty)
୬. All-rounder - ସର୍ବଗୁଣସମ୍ପନ୍ନ ଖେଳାଳି (A player skilled in both batting and bowling)
୭. Rigorous - କଠୋର / ନିଷ୍ଠାପର (Extremely thorough and demanding)
୮. Inspiration - ପ୍ରେରଣା (Encouragement or drive)
୯. Debut - ପ୍ରଥମ ଅଭିନୟ ବା ଖେଳ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ (First public appearance/match)
୧୦. Captaincy - ଅଧିନାୟକତ୍ୱ (Leadership of a team)

title: 7. ନୂତନ ଶବ୍ଦଭଣ୍ଡାର
content:
୧. Sector 16 Cricket Club: The cricket ground/club in Chandigarh where Kapil Dev started his cricket training.
୨. Desh Prem Azad: The famous coach who trained and guided Kapil Dev during his early cricket career.
୩. Straight from the Heart: The famous autobiography of Kapil Dev.
୪. Prudential World Cup: The official name of the 1983 Cricket World Cup won by India under Kapil Dev's captaincy.
୫. All-rounder: A cricketer who excels in both batting and bowling.

title: 8. ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବାକ୍ୟ ଓ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା
content:
୧. Line: 'I was born on 6th January 1959 in Chandigarh.'
Explanation: ଏହି ବାକ୍ୟରେ Kapil Dev ନିଜର ଜନ୍ମ ତାରିଖ ଓ ଜନ୍ମସ୍ଥାନ ବିଷୟରେ ସୂଚନା ଦେଇଛନ୍ତି। ଚଣ୍ଡୀଗଡ଼ ସହରରେ ତାଙ୍କର ପିଲାଦିନ ବିତିଥିଲା।

୨. Line: 'Like any other child, I was naughty and loved outdoor sports.'
Explanation: Kapil Dev ଦର୍ଶାଇଛନ୍ତି ଯେ ଅନ୍ୟ ସାଧାରଣ ପିଲାଙ୍କ ପରି ସେ ମଧ୍ୟ ନଟଖଟ ଥିଲେ ଏବଂ ଘର ଭିତରେ ରହିବା ଅପେକ୍ଷା ବାହାରେ ଖେଳିବାକୁ ବେଶୀ ଭଲପାଉଥିଲେ।

୩. Line: 'Cricket gradually became my passion and career.'
Explanation: ଛୋଟବେଳେ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ଖେଳ ଖେଳୁଥିବା Kapil Dev କ୍ରମଶଃ କ୍ରିକେଟ ପ୍ରତି ଆକର୍ଷିତ ହୋଇଥିଲେ ଏବଂ ଏହାକୁ ନିଜର ଜୀବନ ଓ ଜୀବିକା ଭାବେ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରିଥିଲେ।

title: 9. ଚରିତ୍ର ପରିଚୟ
content:
ଏହି ଅଧ୍ୟାୟରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଚରିତ୍ରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ହେଲେ:
୧. Kapil Dev: ଭାରତର ମହାନ କ୍ରିକେଟର, ୧୯୮୩ ବିଶ୍ୱକପ ବିଜେତା ଅଧିନାୟକ ଏବଂ ଅଧ୍ୟାୟର କଥକ (Narrator)।
୨. Desh Prem Azad: Kapil Dev ଙ୍କର କ୍ରିକେଟ କୋଚ୍/ପ୍ରଶିକ୍ଷକ, ଯିଏ ତାଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତିଭାକୁ ଚିହ୍ନି ପ୍ରଶିକ୍ଷଣ ଦେଇଥିଲେ।
୩. Kapil's Childhood Friends: Kapil Dev ଙ୍କ ସାଙ୍ଗମାନେ, ଯେଉଁମାନେ ତାଙ୍କ ସହ ବଗିଚାରୁ ଫଳ ତୋଳିବା ଓ ଖେଳିବାରେ ସାଥୀ ଥିଲେ।

title: 10. ଚରିତ୍ର ଚିତ୍ରଣ
content:
Character Sketch of Kapil Dev (Kapil Dev ଙ୍କ ଚରିତ୍ର ଚିତ୍ରଣ):
Kapil Dev ହେଉଛନ୍ତି ଜଣେ ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସରଳ, ପରିଶ୍ରମୀ, ନିଷ୍ଠାପର ଏବଂ ପ୍ରେରଣାଦାୟୀ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିତ୍ୱ। ଛୋଟବେଳେ ସେ ନଟଖଟ ଓ ଖେଳକୁଦ ପ୍ରିୟ ଥିଲେ। କ୍ରିକେଟ ପ୍ରତି ତାଙ୍କର ଅସୀମ ଆଗ୍ରହ, ଅକ୍ଲାନ୍ତ ପରିଶ୍ରମ ଏବଂ ଅନୁଶାସନ ତାଙ୍କୁ ବିଶ୍ୱର ଅନ୍ୟତମ ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ All-rounder ଭାବେ ଗଢ଼ିତୋଳିଥିଲା। ଜଣେ ନେତା/ଅଧିନାୟକ ଭାବରେ ସେ ଦଳକୁ ଏକାଠି କରି ୧୯୮୩ ବିଶ୍ୱକପରେ ବିଜୟୀ କରାଇଥିଲେ। ତାଙ୍କର ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଓ ସକାରାତ୍ମକ ମନୋଭାବ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଯୁବପିଢ଼ି ପାଇଁ ଉଦାହରଣ।

title: 11. କାହାଣୀର ସାରାଂଶ
content: 'Kapil Dev' ଅଧ୍ୟାୟଟି Kapil Dev ଙ୍କ ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳର ନଟଖଟ ସ୍ମୃତିରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇ ତାଙ୍କର ସଫଳ କ୍ରିକେଟ କ୍ୟାରିୟର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଗତି କରିଛି। ଚଣ୍ଡୀଗଡ଼ରେ ବଡ଼ ହୋଇଥିବା Kapil Dev ଛୋଟବେଳେ ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ମିଶି ଫଳ ବଗିଚାରୁ ଆମ୍ବ ଓ ପେୟାରା/ଆତ ତୋଳିବାର ଆନନ୍ଦ ନେଉଥିଲେ। ବୟସ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ସହ ତାଙ୍କର କ୍ରୀଡ଼ାପ୍ରେମ କ୍ରିକେଟ ଆଡ଼କୁ ମୁହାଁଇଥିଲା। କୋଚ Desh Prem Azad ଙ୍କ ଅଧୀନରେ କଠୋର ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କରି ସେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ହରିୟାଣା ଏବଂ ପରେ ଭାରତୀୟ ଜାତୀୟ ଦଳରେ ଯୋଗଦେଲେ। ତାଙ୍କ ନେତୃତ୍ୱରେ ଭାରତ ୧୯୮୩ ମସିହାରେ ବିଶ୍ୱକପ ଜିତି କ୍ରିକେଟ ଇତିହାସରେ ନୂଆ ପୃଷ୍ଠା ଯୋଡ଼ିଥିଲା।

title: 12. ଘଟଣାକ୍ରମ
content:
୧. ୧୯୫୯ ମସିହା ଜାନୁଆରୀ ୬ ରେ ଚଣ୍ଡୀଗଡ଼ରେ Kapil Dev ଙ୍କ ଜନ୍ମ।
୨. ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳରେ ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ଖେଳିବା ଓ ପଡ଼ୋଶୀଙ୍କ ବଗିଚାରୁ ଫଳ ତୋଳିବାର ନଟଖଟ ଅନୁଭୂତି।
୩. ପ୍ରଥମେ ଟେବୁଲ ଟେନିସ ଓ ଫୁଟବଲ ଆଦି ଖେଳିବା ଏବଂ ପରେ କ୍ରିକେଟ ପ୍ରତି ଆକର୍ଷିତ ହେବା।
୪. ଚଣ୍ଡୀଗଡ଼ର Sector 16 Cricket Club ରେ ଯୋଗଦାନ ଏବଂ କୋଚ Desh Prem Azad ଙ୍କଠାରୁ ପ୍ରଶିକ୍ଷଣ।
୫. ୧୯୭୫ ମସିହାରେ ହରିୟାଣା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରଥମ ଶ୍ରେଣୀ କ୍ରିକେଟରେ ପଦାର୍ପଣ।
୬. ୧୯୭୮ ମସିହାରେ ପାକିସ୍ତାନ ବିପକ୍ଷରେ ଭାରତୀୟ ଜାତୀୟ କ୍ରିକେଟ ଦଳରେ ପଦାର୍ପଣ।
୭. ୧୯୮୩ ମସିହାରେ ଅଧିନାୟକ ଭାବେ ଭାରତକୁ ପ୍ରଥମ କ୍ରିକେଟ ବିଶ୍ୱକପ ବିଜୟୀ କରାଇବା।

title: 13. କେନ୍ଦ୍ରୀୟ ଭାବ
content: ଏହି ଅଧ୍ୟାୟର କେନ୍ଦ୍ରୀୟ ଭାବ (Central Idea) ହେଉଛି: ପ୍ରତିଭା, ନିରନ୍ତର ପରିଶ୍ରମ, ଏକାଗ୍ରତା ଏବଂ ଆତ୍ମବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଜଣେ ସାଧାରଣ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ମଧ୍ୟ ଜୀବନରେ ଅସାଧାରଣ ସଫଳତା ହାସଲ କରିପାରେ। ପିଲାଦିନର ଆଗ୍ରହ ଓ ସପ୍ନକୁ ଯଦି ସଠିକ ଦିଗ ଏବଂ କଠୋର ଅନୁଶାସନ ଦିଆଯାଏ, ତେବେ ତାହା ବିଶ୍ୱସ୍ତରୀୟ ସଫଳତାରେ ପରିଣତ ହୁଏ।

title: 14. ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ
content:
ଏହି ଅଧ୍ୟାୟର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁଗୁଡ଼ିକ ହେଲା:
୧. Childhood Innocence and Joy (ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳର ନିରୀହତା ଓ ଆନନ୍ଦ)
୨. Transition from Casual Games to Professional Sports (ଖେଳକୁଦରୁ ବ୍ୟବସାୟିକ କ୍ରିକେଟ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଯାତ୍ରା)
୩. Role of Hard Work and Guidance (କଠୋର ପରିଶ୍ରମ ଓ ଗୁରୁ/କୋଚଙ୍କ ଭୂମିକା)
୪. National Pride and World Cup Victory (ଜାତୀୟ ଗୌରବ ଓ ୧୯୮୩ ବିଶ୍ୱକପ ବିଜୟ)

title: 15. କବି / ଲେଖକଙ୍କ ବାର୍ତ୍ତା
content: ଲେଖକ Kapil Dev ଏହି ରଚନା ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଯୁବପିଢ଼ିକୁ ବାର୍ତ୍ତା ଦେଇଛନ୍ତି ଯେ, ନିଜର ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳକୁ ମନଭରି ଉପଭୋଗ କର, କିନ୍ତୁ ନିଜର ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତି ସଦାସର୍ବଦା ନିଷ୍ଠାପର ରୁହ। କୌଣସି ବି ସଫଳତା ବିନା ପରିଶ୍ରମରେ ମିଳେ ନାହିଁ। ନିଜର ଆଗ୍ରହକୁ ଚିହ୍ନି ତାହା ପଛରେ ଦୃଢ଼ତା ସହ ଲାଗିରହିଲେ ସଫଳତା ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ମିଳିବ।

title: 16. କାହାଣୀର ଶିକ୍ଷା
content:
୧. ସଫଳତା ପାଇଁ କଠୋର ପରିଶ୍ରମ ଓ ଅନୁଶାସନ ଅପରିହାର୍ଯ୍ୟ।
୨. ଜୀବନର ଆରମ୍ଭ ଯେତେ ସାଧାରଣ ହେଲେ ବି ବଡ଼ ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ଦେଖିବା ଏବଂ ସେଥିପାଇଁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବା ଉଚିତ।
୩. ସଠିକ ପ୍ରଶିକ୍ଷକ ବା ଗୁରୁଙ୍କ ମାର୍ଗଦର୍ଶନ ଜୀବନର ଦିଗ ବଦଳାଇଦେଇପାରେ।

title: 17. ଭାବ ଓ ପରିବେଶ
content:
ଏହି ଅଧ୍ୟାୟରେ ଦୁଇଟି ମୁଖ୍ୟ ପରିବେଶ ଓ ଭାବ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମିଳେ:
୧. ପ୍ରଥମ ଭାଗରେ: ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳର ନଟଖଟପଣ, ହସଖୁସି, ମଜାମଜଲିସ ଏବଂ ମୁକ୍ତ ପରିବେଶ।
୨. ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଭାଗରେ: କ୍ରିକେଟ ପ୍ରତି ନିଷ୍ଠା, କଠୋର ଅନୁଶାସନ, ସଂଘର୍ଷ, ଜାତୀୟ ଗୌରବ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରେରଣାଦାୟୀ ପରିବେଶ।

title: 18. ଅଳଙ୍କାର / Literary Devices
content:
୧. Autobiographical Narrative Style: ଲେଖକ ନିଜ ଜୀବନର କାହାଣୀକୁ ପ୍ରଥମ ପୁରୁଷ (First Person Narrative - 'I', 'My') ରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରିଛନ୍ତି।
୨. Anecdote: ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳର ଫଳ ଚୋରି କରିବା ଭଳି ମଜାଦାର ଘଟଣାର ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ସୁନ୍ଦର ଉପସ୍ଥାପନା।
୩. Imagery: ଚଣ୍ଡୀଗଡ଼ର ଫଳ ବଗିଚା ଏବଂ କ୍ରିକେଟ ପଡ଼ିଆର ଜୀବନ୍ତ ଚିତ୍ରଣ।

title: 19. Grammar Points
content:
୧. Simple Past Tense for Past Events:
- Example: 'I was born in Chandigarh.' / 'I loved playing outdoor games.'
- ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ: ଅତୀତର ଘଟଣାକୁ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରିବା ପାଇଁ Past Simple Tense ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଇଛି।

୨. Prepositions of Time and Place:
- 'in Chandigarh' (Place)
- 'on 6th January 1959' (Time)
- 'in 1983' (Year)

୩. Word Formation:
- Passion -> Passionate (Adjective)
- Perform -> Performance (Noun)

title: 20. ପରୀକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବିନ୍ଦୁ
content:
୧. Date and Place of Birth: 6th January 1959 in Chandigarh.
୨. Autobiography Name: 'Straight from the Heart'.
୩. Childhood Hobbies: Playing outdoor games, picking mangoes and pomegranates from neighbors' orchards.
୪. Cricket Club Joined: Sector 16 Cricket Club, Chandigarh.
୫. Coach Name: Desh Prem Azad.
୬. First Class Debut: 1975 for Haryana.
୭. International Debut: 1978 against Pakistan at Faisalabad.
୮. Major Achievement: Led India to win the Prudential World Cup in 1983.
୯. Special Role: World-class All-rounder (Fast bowler and aggressive batsman).
୧୦. Famous World Cup Innings: 175* against Zimbabwe in 1983.

title: 21. ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସାରାଂଶ
content: 'Kapil Dev' ହେଉଛି ଭାରତର ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ କ୍ରିକେଟର Kapil Dev ଙ୍କ ଜୀବନୀମୂଳକ ପାଠ। ୧୯୫୯ ମସିହା ଜାନୁଆରୀ ୬ ରେ ଚଣ୍ଡୀଗଡ଼ରେ ଜନ୍ମଗ୍ରହଣ କରିଥିବା Kapil Dev ଛୋଟବେଳେ ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଚଞ୍ଚଳ ଓ ଖେଳପ୍ରିୟ ଥିଲେ। ସେ ନିଜ ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ପଡ଼ୋଶୀଙ୍କ ବଗିଚାରୁ ଫଳ ତୋଳିବାର ଆନନ୍ଦ ନେଉଥିଲେ। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସମୟରେ Sector 16 Cricket Club ରେ ଯୋଗଦେଇ କୋଚ Desh Prem Azad ଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଶିକ୍ଷଣରେ ସେ ଜଣେ ଦକ୍ଷ କ୍ରିକେଟର ଭାବେ ଗଢ଼ିଉଠିଲେ। ୧୯୭୫ ରେ ହରିୟାଣା ପାଇଁ ଏବଂ ୧୯୭୮ ରେ ଭାରତୀୟ ଜାତୀୟ ଦଳ ପାଇଁ ଖେଳିବା ଆରମ୍ଭ କଲେ। ୧୯୮୩ ମସିହାରେ ତାଙ୍କ ଅଧିନାୟକତ୍ୱରେ ଭାରତ ପ୍ରଥମ ବିଶ୍ୱକପ ଜିତି ଐତିହାସିକ ଗୌରବ ହାସଲ କରିଥିଲା।

title: 22. ଉପସଂହାର
content: ପରିଶେଷରେ, Kapil Dev ଙ୍କ ଜୀବନ କାହାଣୀ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ପାଠକ ଓ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପ୍ରେରଣାଦାୟୀ। ଏହା ଦର୍ଶାଏ ଯେ ସାଧାରଣ ବାଲ୍ୟକାଳରୁ ବାହାରି ଦୃଢ଼ ଇଚ୍ଛାଶକ୍ତି, କଠୋର ପରିଶ୍ରମ, ଏବଂ ଅନୁଶାସନ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଜଣେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ବିଶ୍ୱସ୍ତରରେ ସଫଳତା ପାଇପାରିବ। BSE Odisha Class 10 ପରୀକ୍ଷା ଦୃଷ୍ଟିରୁ ଏହି ଅଧ୍ୟାୟଟି ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ।

title: 10 ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଓ ଉତ୍ତର
content:

Ans: Kapil Dev describes his childhood as full of energy, mischief, and fun. He spent most of his time outdoors playing games and exploring with his friends.

Q2. Describe Kapil Dev's fruit-picking adventure with his friends.
Ans: Kapil Dev and his friends used to climb trees in nearby orchards to pick mangoes and pomegranates. Although they were sometimes caught and scolded by orchard owners, it was an exciting adventure for them.

Q3. How did Kapil Dev enter professional cricket?
Ans: Kapil Dev entered professional cricket by joining Sector 16 Cricket Club in Chandigarh, where he received formal training under coach Desh Prem Azad and honed his skills.

Q4. What role did Desh Prem Azad play in Kapil Dev's cricket journey?
Ans: Desh Prem Azad was Kapil Dev's coach who recognized his potential, disciplined him, and gave him rigorous training to become a top-class all-rounder.

Q5. Mention Kapil Dev's achievements in the 1983 World Cup.
Ans: In the 1983 World Cup, Kapil Dev scored a legendary 175* against Zimbabwe when India was struggling at 17/5, and he successfully led India to win the World Cup title.

Q6. Why is Kapil Dev considered one of India's greatest all-rounders?
Ans: Kapil Dev is considered one of India's greatest all-rounders because he excelled both as an explosive batsman and as a world-class fast bowler, taking over 400 Test wickets.

Q7. What lesson do we learn from Kapil Dev's early life?
Ans: We learn that childhood interests, when nurtured with hard work, dedication, and discipline, can transform into an extraordinary and successful career.

Q8. How did Kapil Dev balance fun and sports in his youth?
Ans: In his youth, Kapil Dev enjoyed innocent fun like playing outdoor games and fruit picking, but as he grew up, he turned his energy towards dedicated sports training.

Ans: His self-confidence, leadership from the front, positive attitude, aggressive gameplay, and ability to motivate his team made him a successful captain.

title: 10 ଦୀର୍ଘ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଓ ବୋର୍ଡ ଶୈଳୀର ଉତ୍ତର
content:
Q1. Describe Kapil Dev's childhood days and how his playful nature shaped his personality.
Ans: Kapil Dev was born on January 6, 1959, in Chandigarh. As a child, he was extremely lively, energetic, and full of mischief. Instead of staying indoors, he spent long hours outside playing games with his friends. One of his favorite childhood pastimes was visiting nearby orchards to pick mangoes and pomegranates. Though they often got caught and scolded, these experiences taught him fearlessness, teamwork, and agility. His boundless physical energy and love for outdoor activities laid a strong foundation for his future athletic and cricketing career.

Q2. Write about Kapil Dev's journey from a young boy in Chandigarh to an international cricket legend.
Ans: Kapil Dev's journey started in Chandigarh, where he played casual outdoor games before turning his focus to cricket. He joined Sector 16 Cricket Club and was trained by coach Desh Prem Azad. Through relentless hard work and discipline, he debuted for Haryana in 1975 at the age of 16. In 1978, he made his international debut against Pakistan. With his lethal fast bowling and powerful batting, he quickly established himself as India's premier all-rounder. The pinnacle of his career came in 1983 when he led India to a historic Prudential World Cup victory.

Q3. Discuss the significance of India's victory in the 1983 World Cup under Kapil Dev's captaincy.
Ans: Before 1983, India was considered an underdog in international cricket. Under Kapil Dev's dynamic leadership, the Indian team transformed completely. In a crucial match against Zimbabwe, Kapil Dev scored an unforgettable 175* after India was reduced to 17/5. In the final at Lord's, India defended a modest total of 183 against the mighty West Indies. This historic victory put India on the world cricket map, instilled immense national pride, and inspired generations of young Indians to pursue cricket as a profession.

Q4. What values and qualities of Kapil Dev emerge from his autobiographical narrative?
Ans: Kapil Dev's narrative reveals several admirable qualities. First, his honesty and humility are evident in how openly he shares his childhood mischiefs. Second, his dedication and hard work show his commitment to mastering cricket. Third, his courage and leadership under pressure guided India through challenging matches. Finally, his patriotism and passion for sports demonstrate that genuine passion combined with self-belief can overcome any obstacle.

Q5. Describe the role of Kapil Dev's coach Desh Prem Azad in shaping his career.
Ans: Coach Desh Prem Azad played a pivotal role in Kapil Dev's transformation from a raw talent to a world-class player. At Sector 16 Cricket Club in Chandigarh, Azad recognized Kapil's immense physical strength and bowling speed. He subjected Kapil to tough training sessions and instilled strict discipline. Azad's guidance helped Kapil refine his technique, build stamina, and develop a winning mindset that sustained him throughout his international career.

Q6. How does Kapil Dev contrast his casual childhood games with professional cricket training?
Ans: In his early years, sports were purely a source of fun, freedom, and entertainment for Kapil Dev. He played table tennis, football, and informal cricket without any formal coaching. However, once he joined the cricket club, he realized that professional sports require rigorous discipline, daily practice, physical fitness, and mental strength. While childhood games gave him joy and agility, professional training gave him focus and a career goal.

Q7. Give a critical evaluation of the chapter 'Kapil Dev' as an inspiring reading for students.
Ans: The chapter 'Kapil Dev' is a highly motivating text for Class 10 students. Written in a simple, direct, and conversational style, it connects easily with young readers. By sharing both his everyday childhood adventures and his massive professional triumphs, Kapil Dev conveys that greatness is not innate but built through effort. It inspires students to pursue their dreams with passion, remain humble, and face challenges with confidence.

Q8. Explain Kapil Dev's historic innings of 175* against Zimbabwe in the 1983 World Cup.
Ans: During the 1983 World Cup match against Zimbabwe at Tunbridge Wells, India was in deep trouble at 17/5. Kapil Dev walked in to bat under tremendous pressure. Displaying exceptional courage, counter-attacking spirit, and power-hitting, he scored 175 runs not out off 138 balls, including 16 fours and 6 sixes. This remarkable innings saved India from elimination, led to a crucial victory, and remains one of the greatest ODI innings in cricket history.

Q9. How does Kapil Dev's life story demonstrate the importance of sports in personality development?
Ans: Kapil Dev's life demonstrates that sports play a vital role in building character. Participating in sports helped him channel his childhood energy constructively. It taught him discipline, team spirit, decision-making under pressure, and resilience in the face of defeat. Moreover, sports gave him a sense of purpose and elevated a young boy from Chandigarh into a national hero and global icon.

Q10. What key takeaways should Class 10 students keep in mind for BSE Odisha board exams from this chapter?
Ans: Students should focus on key biographical facts (birth date, birthplace, autobiography title), key names (Desh Prem Azad, Sector 16 Cricket Club, Haryana, 1983 World Cup, Zimbabwe match score 175*), and the main themes (hard work, discipline, patriotism, transformation from childhood games to professional cricket). Understanding these elements will enable students to answer short, medium, and long essay-type questions accurately in board exams.
